claims.text: The study was published in the Journal of Imaging on June 27th, 2026.
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The study covers a 15 room cardiothoracic operating suite at Houston Methodist Hospital.
claims.quote: in a 15-room cardiothoracic suite at Houston Methodist Hospital (HMH)
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: Each operating room in the suite was fitted with four high resolution wall mounted cameras.
claims.quote: Each operating room was outfitted with four high-resolution wall-mounted cameras
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The image based AI software was deployed at Walter Tower in December 2022.
claims.quote: The IBAI software was deployed at Walter Tower (WT) in December 2022.
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The study window ran 16 months, 6 before deployment and 10 after, and covered 5417 surgical cases at the suite.
claims.quote: Over a 16-month period spanning 6 months pre-deployment and 10 months post-deployment, the system monitored 5417 surgical cases
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The study estimates the deployment was associated with about 25 more cases a month, with a 95% confidence interval of 8.3 to 41.0, about 7% above baseline.
claims.quote: showed a statistically significant increase of approximately 25 cases per month (95% CI 8.3 to 41.0; p < 0.01; Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.05), corresponding to a 7% increase in monthly case volume relative to baseline
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The paper puts the suite's baseline at approximately 339 cases a month.
claims.quote: roughly 7% against a baseline of approximately 339 cases per month
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: In the placebo permutation test Walter Tower ranked second of 11 units, an empirical p of 0.182.
claims.quote: Walter Tower had the second-largest ratio of post-deployment to pre-deployment prediction error among the 11 units (Walter Tower and 10 donor sites; empirical p = 0.182)
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The authors write that the permutation result points the same way as the main estimate but does not reach conventional statistical significance.
claims.quote: the permutation result is directionally consistent with the difference-in-differences estimate but does not reach conventional statistical significance
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The authors interpret the rise in case volume as associated with the deployment rather than caused by it.
claims.quote: we interpret the case-volume effect as associated with, rather than caused by, IBAI deployment
claims.document: Journal of Imaging, Implementation of Image-Based Artificial Intelligence Is Associated with Increased Case Volume in a High-Acuity, 15-Room Cardiothoracic Operating Suite at a Tertiary Academic Hospital

claims.text: The estimate covers the technology platform and its change management program together, and the study can't attribute the gains to either one alone.

claims.text: A sensitivity analysis found no statistically significant change in total operative minutes a month.
